en: Ever since Nobuko was studying at a women's university, she had been known as a talented young woman, and everyone thought that sooner or later she would make her mark in the literary world and become an excellent writer.
u.src: 信子从在女子大学读书的时候，就有了才媛的称号，大家都认为早晚有一天，她会在文坛崭露头角，成为一个优秀的作家。

en: Some people even spread the story that while she was still in school she had written an autobiographical novel of more than three hundred pages.
u.src: 有人还宣扬说，她在读书的时候就写了自传体小说，多达三百多页。

en: But after she graduated, things were no longer so simple,
u.src: 但是自从毕业之后，事情就变得没那么简单了，

en: her mother had been widowed for many years and had raised Nobuko and her younger sister alone,
u.src: 母亲多年守寡，一个人抚养自己和妹妹，

en: and her younger sister was still studying at a girls' school; thinking of all this,
u.src: 如今妹妹还在女子学校读书，想到这些，

en: Nobuko could not selfishly insist on following her own wishes.
u.src: 信子便没办法任性的坚持自己的心意。

en: Therefore, before she could set out on the path of writing,
u.src: 因此，在她开始写作之路之前，

en: she first had to think about the serious matter of marriage, something worldly life required her to consider.
u.src: 不得不先考虑俗世中必须考虑的婚姻大事。

en: Nobuko's cousin Shunkichi was still studying in the humanities department at the university then,
u.src: 信子的表兄俊吉，那时候还在大学的文科系读书，

en: and he too hoped that someday he might be called a writer.
u.src: 他也希望自己将来可以称为作家。

en: Nobuko had long been in frequent contact with this university senior of hers,
u.src: 信子和自己的这位大学生师兄一直来往频繁，

en: and besides, the two of them shared an interest in literature,
u.src: 而且，他们之间还有文学这个共同爱好，

en: so they gradually became more intimate.
u.src: 因为日渐亲密起来。
但是，和信子不一样，

en: Shunkichi had no respect at all for the mainstream literary ideas represented by Tolstoy,
u.src: 俊吉对以托尔斯泰为代表的主流文学思想毫无敬业，

en: and he was always showing off those ironic aphorisms imported from France.
u.src: 他总是显摆那些法国舶来的讽言警语。
俊吉这种嘲讽的态度，

en: often made Nobuko, who insisted on being careful and serious in everything, angry.
u.src: 经常会让凡事坚持谨慎严肃的信子生气。
但是，信子尽管生气，

ja: んじられないものがあると
en: she also felt that there was something in Shunkichi's ironic aphorisms that could not be taken lightly.
u.src: 但是也认为俊吉的讽言警语中也有一种不能被轻视的东西。

en: Therefore, when they were in school, Nobuko and Shunkichi often went together to see exhibitions and hear concerts, and Nobuko's younger sister came along every time.
u.src: 因此，上学的时候，信子和俊吉常常一起看展览、听音乐会，且每次自己的妹妹都会同行。

en: On the way there and back, the three of them talked and laughed, though now and then the younger sister, Teruko, could not join in.
u.src: 来回的路上，三个人有说有笑，只是偶尔，妹妹照子会插不上话。

en: But Teruko was still a child, and as she walked she looked at the parasols, silk shawls, and the like in the shop windows, so even if she could not join the conversation, she did not grow unhappy.
u.src: 不过，照子还是小孩子，边走边看橱窗里的太阳伞、丝绸披肩之类的，即使插不上话，她也不会不高兴。

en: Still, whenever Nobuko noticed, she would always switch to a topic her younger sister could take part in.
u.src: 不过信子如果察觉到，就一定会转换到能让妹妹参与进来的话题。

en: Even so, as the talk went on, Nobuko would again forget how her younger sister was feeling.
u.src: 话虽如此，聊着聊着信子就又会忘了妹妹的情绪。

en: Shunkichi seemed not to mind any of this; amid the unending stream of people, he always strode along at ease, telling amusing jokes as he went.
u.src: 俊吉似乎对这些并不在意，在络绎不绝的人流中，他总是一边说着有趣的笑话，一边悠闲的阔步前行。

en: In anyone's eyes, Nobuko and her cousin seemed destined to marry.
u.src: 不管在任何人眼里看来，信子和表兄的未来都是会结婚的。

en: All her classmates greatly envied Nobuko's future, and especially those who did not know Shunkichi at all felt even stronger envy and jealousy toward her, which can only be called absurd.
u.src: 同窗们都十分羡慕信子的未来，尤其是那些压根不认识俊吉的人对她的羡慕嫉妒之情更加强烈——这只能说是滑稽。

en: While Nobuko denied it, she also seemed to hint, almost unintentionally, that it was in fact true.
u.src: 信子一边否认这件事，这边却又似乎尤以无意的暗示确有其事。

en: In this way, by the time graduation came, everyone regarded Nobuko and Shunkichi as an unquestionable couple practically engaged to be married.
u.src: 就这样，到了毕业时刻，大家都觉得信子和俊吉是毋庸置疑是一堆准夫妻。

en: But not long after graduation, to her classmates' surprise, Nobuko suddenly married a young stranger who had graduated from a higher commercial school and was about to take up a post at a trading company in Osaka.
u.src: 可是，毕业后没多久，信子却出乎同学们的意料，突然嫁给了一位毕业于高等商业学校的、马上要到大阪某商社赴任的陌生青年。

en: Moreover, not long after the wedding, Nobuko followed her husband to Osaka.
u.src: 而且，婚后没多久，信子就跟随丈夫去了大阪。

en: According to those who went to Central Station to see them off at the time, Nobuko wore her usual cheerful smile and kept comforting her tearful younger sister Teruko.
u.src: 据当时去中央车站给他们送行的人说，信子和往常一样，面露欢乐的笑容，还一直在安慰爱哭的妹妹照子。

en: All the classmates found it hard to believe.
u.src: 同学们都觉得难以置信。

en: Within their disbelief there was also a strange feeling of joy, and a jealousy completely unlike anything they had felt before.
u.src: 在难以置信的情绪里，也有一种莫名的欢乐的情绪，还有一种和以前完全不一样的嫉妒心情。

en: Some believed Nobuko and thought she had no choice but to follow her mother's arrangement.
u.src: 有的人相信信子，认为她是不得不听从母亲的安排。

en: Others doubted Nobuko and thought she had changed her mind.
u.src: 有的人怀疑信子，认为她是变了心。

en: But in any case, even if all of this was only guesswork, they themselves understood it very well.
u.src: 但无论如何，这些即使都是猜测，她们自己也非常清楚。

en: Why had Nobuko not married Shunkichi?
u.src: 信子为什么没有嫁给俊吉？

en: After that, they often discussed the question.
u.src: 在那之后，她们经常讨论这个问题。

ja: になりたがっていたことも
en: In this way two months passed, and they forgot Nobuko herself; naturally, they also forgot that she had wanted to become a novelist.
u.src: 就这样过了俩月，她们就忘了信子这个人，当然也忘了信子想要成为小说作者这件事。

en: During this time, in the outskirts of Osaka, Nobuko's new household, which should have been happy, had settled down in the Osaka suburbs.
u.src: 这期间，在大阪的郊外，信子理应幸福的新家庭在大阪郊外安顿好了。

en: Their new house stood in a quiet grove of pines, with the scent of pine resin and warm, gentle sunlight--
u.src: 他们的新房在幽静的松树林中，松树脂的香味，和煦的阳光——

en: Of course, because her husband was seldom at home, the rented two-story cottage, though full of life, was far too quiet.
u.src: 当然，因为丈夫很少在家，租来的二层小楼虽然生机勃勃但是却过于安静。

en: On quiet afternoons, Nobuko often felt low in spirits,
u.src: 在安静的午后，信子经常觉得心情不好，

en: and whenever her mood sank, she would invariably take from the drawer of her sewing box the pink letter paper neatly folded at the very bottom.
u.src: 每当心情低落的时候，她必定会从针线箱的抽屉里拿出整齐的叠在最下面的粉红色信笺。

en: On the letter paper, written densely and finely in pen, were the words:
u.src: 信笺上用钢笔细细密密的写着：

en: Just thinking that from today on, my sister and I can no longer live together,
u.src: ——只要想到从今天开始，我和姐姐就再也不能生活在一起了，

en: as I write this letter, my tears will not stop flowing.
u.src: 写下这封信的时候，我便泪流不止。
姐姐，恳请你，恳请你原谅我，

ja: ってくださったことは、
en: I, Teruko, cannot put into words the great sacrifice you made for me.
u.src: 姐姐为我做了如此大的牺牲，照子难以言表。

en: My sister became engaged entirely for my sake.
u.src: 姐姐都是为了我才会订婚。

en: Even if you will not admit it, I know it in my heart.
u.src: 即使你不承认，但是我心里明白。

en: On the night we went to the Imperial Theater together, my sister asked me whether I liked A-Jun.
u.src: 我们一起去帝国剧院的那天晚上，姐姐问我是不是喜欢阿俊。

en: You also told me that if I liked him, you would surely help me and let me marry A-Jun.
u.src: 你还对我说，假如我喜欢的话，姐姐一定会成全我，让我和阿俊结婚。

en: By then, you had already read the letter I wrote to A-Jun, had you not?
u.src: 那时候，姐姐已经看过我写给阿俊的信了吧。

en: When I could not find that letter, I really did resent you.
u.src: 找不到那封信的时候，我确实怨恨过姐姐。

en: I am very sorry; for this matter alone, I am filled with remorse.
u.src: （很抱歉，只是这件事，我就充满了歉意。）

en: Because of that, I always felt that the kind words you spoke to me that night were meant as mockery.
u.src: 因此，那天晚上姐姐对我亲切的话语，我一直觉得是嘲讽。

en: You must still remember that I was very angry then and did not answer seriously.
u.src: 你必定还记得，那时候我还很愤怒，也没认真的回答。

en: But two or three days later, you suddenly became engaged,
u.src: 但是两三天之后，姐姐突然订婚了，

en: and at that time I thought that even if it killed me, I had to apologize to you,
u.src: 那个时候我想即使是死，也要跟姐姐表达歉意，

en: so I knew that in your heart you liked A-Jun too.
u.src: 因此我知道姐姐心里也喜欢阿俊。

en: Do not deny it; I saw it with my own eyes.
u.src: （不要不承认，我看在眼里呢。）

en: If you had not been considerate of my feelings, you would surely have married A-Jun.
u.src: 姐姐如果不是照顾我的感受，必定会和阿俊结婚。

en: Even so, you kept telling me again and again that A-Jun was not in your heart.
u.src: 虽然这样，姐姐却反复跟我说，说你心里没有阿俊。

en: And so you married against your own heart.
u.src: 就这样，姐姐违背了自己的心意结婚了。

en: Oh, my sister, the person dearest to my heart!
u.src: 我心里最在意的姐姐啊！

en: You remember, do you not, that today I even brought the chicken I raised, so it could say goodbye to you too.
u.src: 你还记得吧，我今天把我养的鸡也带来了，让它也跟姐姐告别。

en: Originally, I wanted the chicken I raised and I myself to apologize to you together.
u.src: 原本，我是想让我养的鸡和我自己一起跟姐姐致歉。

en: But in the end, Mother, who had no idea about any of this, cried too.
u.src: 但是，最后对此毫无察觉的妈妈也哭了。

en: Big sister, tomorrow you will start living in Osaka.
u.src: 姐姐，明天你就到大阪生活了。

en: But I beg you, please do not forget your younger sister Teruko.
u.src: 但是，恳求你不要忘记妹妹照子。

en: Every morning when I feed the chickens, I think of you and end up crying...
u.src: 我每天早上喂鸡的时候，都会因为想到姐姐而流泪……

en: Every time Nobuko saw this letter, so full of a young girl's feeling, she could not help shedding tears.
u.src: 每次看到这封少女气息慢慢的信，信子都会不由的流泪。

en: Especially when she thought of how Teruko had secretly thrust the letter into her hands in front of Central Station, Nobuko's heart ached all the more.
u.src: 尤其是想到照子在中央车站前偷偷塞给自己这封信时的样子，信子就会更加心痛。

en: But was her present marriage really, as her younger sister said, a complete sacrifice?
u.src: 但是她如今的婚姻，难道真的像妹妹所说的那样是彻底的牺牲吗？

en: This doubt made her mood after crying sink even lower,
u.src: 这个怀疑让她哭过之后的心情更加消沉，

en: To keep from sinking into that dejection, Nobuko would usually immerse herself in a cheerful melancholy and gaze at the exquisite scenery of the pine grove, where sunlight poured through the trees from morning until dusk.
u.src: 为了不沉浸在这种消沉中，信子一般会让自己沉浸在欢乐的感伤中，眺望松林的绝美风景——阳光洒在松林中，从朝阳到夕暮。
